description:
Bundles the analyzers, synonym sets, and overrides used to build a SearchIndex. A SearchConfiguration is the equivalent of the analyzer wiring in an OpenSearch index settings block — it points at the default index-time and search-time analyzers, lists the SynonymSets to apply, and adds any per-column analyzer overrides. Bind one to a project (or any entity) and every SearchIndex below it inherits the configuration.

Example using the system-bootstrapped SCIENTIFIC analyzer plus two SynonymSets from another organization:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "publications_v1",
  "defaultIndexAnalyzer":  "org.sagebionetworks-SCIENTIFIC",
  "defaultSearchAnalyzer": "org.sagebionetworks-SCIENTIFIC",
  "synonymSets": ["org123-medical_terms", "org123-disease_acronyms"]
}

How synonyms get into the index: any TextAnalyzer whose filter chain contains the reserved token synapse_synonyms has that token expanded at build time, in place, into the qnames listed in synonymSets (in order). The bootstrapped system analyzers ship with synapse_synonyms positioned at the OpenSearch-recommended slot in their chains (after lowercase, before any case-folding or n-gram filter); user-authored TextAnalyzers must include synapse_synonyms in their indexFilterOrder / searchFilterOrder explicitly if they want synonyms applied — see TextAnalyzerSettings. A SearchConfiguration with synonymSets pointed at an analyzer that lacks the placeholder will build successfully, but no synonyms will be applied to that analyzer.

See SearchConfigBinding for how the configuration attaches to a project, TextAnalyzer / ColumnAnalyzerOverride for the analyzer components, and SynonymSet for the synonyms themselves.

id.description: The unique ID of this search configuration.

organizationName.description: The Organization that owns this resource. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Resource name (letters, digits, underscores, must start with a letter). Combined with organizationName to form the qualified name '{organizationName}-{name}'. Immutable after creation.

defaultIndexAnalyzer.description: Optional. Qualified name ('{organizationName}-{name}') of the TextAnalyzer applied at INDEX time to text columns without an override. This is the analyzer that runs against documents as they are written to OpenSearch — see the OpenSearch docs on index analyzers. If omitted, each column falls back to the system default analyzer for its data type (see ColumnTypeToOpenSearchMapping).

defaultSearchAnalyzer.description: Optional. Qualified name of the TextAnalyzer applied at SEARCH time to text columns without an override. Often the same as defaultIndexAnalyzer; differs when index-time and search-time should produce different token streams (e.g. edge_ngram at index time but not at search time — the typical autocomplete pattern). See OpenSearch search analyzers. If omitted, each column falls back to the system default analyzer for its data type (see ColumnTypeToOpenSearchMapping).

synonymSets.description: Optional ordered list of SynonymSet qualified names ('{organizationName}-{name}'). Each one referenced here is rendered as a named OpenSearch synonym filter in the index's analysis settings. They are injected into every TextAnalyzer (defaults and per-column overrides) whose filter chain contains the reserved token 'synapse_synonyms' — expanded in place, in order — see TextAnalyzerSettings for the injection rule. Each SynonymSet keeps its own parameters (synonym vs synonym_graph, expand, lenient, format) when expanded — they are applied as sequential filters, not merged. Build fails at create/update time if any listed qname does not resolve to an existing SynonymSet.

columnAnalyzerOverrides.description: Optional ordered list of ColumnAnalyzerOverride qualified names. Each one names per-column analyzer assignments; first match wins for duplicated column names across overrides.

etag.description: Synapse Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) value. Send the etag from a GET back on update; a mismatch returns 409.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: When this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user that last modified this resource.
